exposure: Homozygous splice site variant (c.4-1G>C; NM_024926.3) in the tetratricopeptide repeat domain 26 (TTC26) gene
outcome: Cystic dilatation of intrahepatic biliary ducts
BRENS syndrome (biliary, renal, neurological, and skeletal features)
cohort: The study describes a proband from a nonconsanguineous Saudi family exhibiting features of a severe ciliopathy disorder.
finding: The study identified a novel homozygous splice site variant (c.4-1G>C) in the TTC26 gene that cosegregates with a severe ciliopathy disorder, which they named BRENS syndrome, characterized by diverse biliary, renal, neurological, and skeletal manifestations.
